findings: Published-version upgrade notices exist; their dev suppression is deliberate.
The one-shot --version path identifies the invoked release, not an RPC query of a running daemon.
Restart receipt verifies the requested build against the disk release stamp; this is not comparison with upstream main.
Installed upgrade refuses replacement when its selected control-plane probe reports a live daemon unless --force is used; this is not proof that every daemon sharing a release is protected.

The inspected standard status/snapshot/dashboard payload constructors have no running-build identity or comparison. Repository-wide source search for source_sha/git_rev/build_stamp/build_sha/running_version found only CLI's compile-time revision under src/lib; this search is not an exhaustive semantic proof.
limits: Read-only source audit; no launcher, upgrade, daemon or release command executed. Negative finding is scoped to inspected standard status/snapshot/presenter paths and named search terms. No universal absence claim and no current GitHub issue-state refresh.
